cover.concept: A small warm orange sphere resting on a calm pale field, facing a tall, softly lit indigo doorway in the distance; the straight path between them is crossed by a long row of thin, closely spaced translucent bars, so the open door is visible but quietly out of reach.

inline.name: too-many-gates
inline.concept: A narrow straight path on a pale field crossed by a long sequence of thin indigo gates, each one slightly taller than the last; a small orange sphere has stopped in front of the first few, and the far end of the path fades into soft light.

inline.name: start-to-send
inline.concept: Two columns of small dots on a pale field: a tall column of muted indigo dots on the left and a much shorter column of warm orange dots on the right, connected by faint thin lines, most of which fade out halfway across the gap.
